title: Keepers for what was lost: every job state, every intern save, the teams' boards, every student and teacher file, and a deleted project kept first
request: Keep what was lost before: tasks' states, intern versions, team runs, students and judgments; a deleted project, draft or session, and events past retention, still in the store.
plan: An intern session's every save as a version.
The store's hook before every delete and before retention.

decisions.decision: The hook sits in each store's delete, not in the route.
decisions.why: The route removed the project before it forgot it; the store's own delete is where every caller passes.

decisions.decision: A database row's whole document goes into its deletion record.
decisions.why: On PostgreSQL a project has no file to keep.

change: Jobs.history (jobs_history.jsonl), intern.sessions.remember, store.hooks (keep_before, before_removal), the deletes of ProjectStore, DraftStore, SessionStore and the PostgreSQL stores, retention.sweep_events and forget.

findings.defect: A deleted project was gone before the store could keep it.
findings.scenario: The route removed the files, then forgot the records.
findings.cause: The hook ran in forget, after the delete.
findings.fix: The hook runs in each store's delete, first.

findings.defect: On PostgreSQL a deleted project left nothing to keep.
findings.fix: The row's document is in the deletion record.

outcome: Nothing DCLab deletes or rewrites is lost to the store: jobs, sessions, boards, students and deleted projects are all kept first.
lessons: Put a capture hook where every caller passes, not where one caller does.
risks: A delete now waits for the workspace's keepers; a very large workspace makes a delete slow.
